data: What is the value of the black dashed line at 10^3 in the plot on the left?

The question asks for the value of the black dashed line at 10^3 in the plot on the left. The plot on the left corresponds to the "Mention Type Identification Task" and shows three lines: red solid line, blue dotted line, and black dashed line. The black dashed line represents the "MegaM" model. At the point where the x-axis is labeled 10^3, the y-value of the black dashed line appears to be approximately 85.
